products.title: The Upside Down: Inverted Attacks by Jon Blank
products.body:
Enter The Upside Down with 10th planet Black Belt and ADCC Vet Jon Blank

  • Change your perspective with Jon’s unorthodox inversions and attacks that will keep your opponent guessing!
  • Techniques like the Rolly Polly Sweep will change the way you think of Jiu-Jitsu Inversions.
  • Blank shows you that it’s not about being crazy flexible, instead it’s all about body placement and technique!
  • As an added bonus Jon Blank goes in depth on EBI-style tactics that will be sure to give you a leg up on the competition.


Enter The Upside Down with 10th planet Black Belt and ADCC Vet Jon Blank

Change your perspective with Jon’s unorthodox inversions and attacks that will keep your opponent guessing!

Check Out The Trailer!

What Will You Learn?

As an ADCC Veteran, Jon Blank knows a thing or two about what it takes to make his techniques work at the highest level. The Upside Down: Inverted Attacks is a compilation of Blanks Go-To tactics. This isn’t your run of the mill instructional that shows you the same technique you have seen a thousand times before. Instead Blank puts his unique twist on EVERY technique!

Not only will you learn the finer points of inverting, you will learn how Jon applies those concepts to positions that aren’t usually considered offensive. Jon shows you how he sets up attacks from north/south and side control BOTTOM! Got your guard passed? No worries, Blank’s side control flower sweep or shotgun armbar from north/south will have you covered. Once again you will be catching your opponent off guard, because once you enter The Upside Down your attacks will be coming from every and ALL directions!

Jon takes the complexities of Inverting and simplifies them in a way that doesn’t require you to be as flexible as say…..Eddie Bravo. Putting your body in the right position is crucial if you are looking to find an effective inversion. On top of all of the treacherous techniques, Blank shows you the stretches and concepts that are key to having the ability to invert. Knowing is half the battle, and with The Upside Down: Inverted Attacks you will learn the essential tips & tricks to becoming an inversion machine that is launching attacks from ALL angles!

So What Do You Get?

Part 1:

 

  • Intro 
  • Back take off hip bump
  • Rolly polly sweep 
  • Rolly polly sweep triangle 
  • Rolly polly sweep armbar 
  • New York/New Jersey 
  • Shot gun arm bar/New York 
  • Shot gun arm bar New Jersey 
  • Mistakes from full guard

Part 2:

 

  • Mini stomp
  • Side control variations 
  • Side flower sweep 
  • Shotgun armbar from side 
  • Preventing the hitchhiker 
  • Crucifix from side 
  • Javier Vasquez hook
  • Javier hook finishes 
  • Twister side control 

Part 3:

  • B-smith
  • D-smith 
  • North south shotgun armbar
  • North south triangle
  • Northsouth leg entry 

Part 4:

  • Back triangle
  • Ebi OT back triangle 
  • Kimura back triangle
  • Armbar back triangle
  • Choke from back triangle 
  • Leg pull from back triangle 
  • Inversion concepts/stretching
  • Outro

So What Does It Cost?

$77

products.title: The Boogeyman Darce by Richie Martinez
products.body:
Attack The Darce Choke with Veteran Competitor & 10th Planet Black Belt Instructor Richie “Boogeyman” Martinez In this Signature Series Dedicated to One of The Most Brutal Chokes in BJJ

  • 10th Planet Back Belt Richie Martinez is one of the organization's most recognized and accomplished figures with world-class competition experience
  • Learn this unique system that will help you find the Darce choke and other serious chokes from multiple positions and scenarios, to help you finish more opponents
  • Explore multiple entries to effective chokes that come off of escapes, passes, sweeps, counters, and more all with signature instruction from one of 10th Planet's most iconic instructors

Connect the Darce, Japanese Necktie, and Peruvian Necktie To Create A Dangerous Triad Of High Percentage Submission Attacks That Will Command More Taps!

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

As one of 10th Planet’s most iconic figures, Bravo Black Belt Richie “Boogeyman” Martinez has helped to push the boundaries of jiu-jitsu with unorthodox and effective techniques and strategies that he’s showcased at the highest levels of grappling. The Darce is one of Boogeyman’s favorite and most high percentage submissions and when paired with the Japanese Necktie, and Peruvian Necktie, a dangerous system of attacking unlike any other can be added to your arsenal! Martinez will introduce you to his favorite ways to attack and pair these important submissions so you can recruit this menacing piece of Boogeyman’s game into your own submission toolbox!

In 3 parts, Martinez will break down the Darce, Japanese Necktie, and Peruvian Necktie with game-changing details, unique to Martinez’s unorthodox style! Learn how to attack the Darce when passing, escaping, seated, and more as you collect high percentage techniques that will surprise your training partners and opponents. Re-learn the Japanese necktie or get a proper first introduction as Martinez shows you his favorite ways to snag this savage choke from the knee on belly, quarter guard, and more! He’ll round out the series with a masterclass on the Peruvian Necktie, completing your study of this dangerous triad, and then show you how to put it all together as you close out the instructional! 

Martinez is known for his unorthodox and effective style of grappling and now you can get an inside look at what makes this important piece of Boogeyman’s game so incredibly dangerous. Pairing these 3 techniques will give you a more dynamic and high percentage method of attacking that will create a larger submission threat and help you to become a more well-equipped grappler! 

So, What Exactly Do You Get?

PART 1

  • INTRODUCTION

    DARCE

  • DARCE BREAKDOWN
  • FROM KNEE SLIDE TO M2 CAN CRUSH TO DARCE
  • FROM GHOST ESCAPE TO VICE GRIP TO DARCE
  • FROM X GUARD SWEEP TO TWISTER SIDE CONTROL TO DARCE
  • BACK ESCAPE TO THE DARCE
  • 50/50 TO DARCE
  • FROM BUTTERFLY TO ARM DRAG TO DARCE
  • COUNTER PASS TO MARCE
  • ROLLING MARCE
  • FLYING OVER TO MARCE

    PART 2

    JAPANESE NECKTIE

  • JAPANESE NECKTIE BREAKDOWN
  • FROM M1 PASS TO KNEE ON BELLY TO JAPANESE NECKTIE
  • FROM M2 TO QUARTER GUARD TO JAPANESE NECKTIE
  • TERRA GUARD SWEEP TO JAPANESE NECKTIE

    PART 3

    PERUVIAN NECKTIE

  • PERUVIAN THROUGH THE FRONT BREAKDOWN
  • PERUVIAN THROUGH THE BACK BREAKDOWN
  • COUNTER SHOT SPRAWL TO PERUVIAN
  • THE COMBINATION OF JAPANESE NECKTIE, DARCE AND PERUVIAN NECKTIE
  • OUTRO


    $77

products.title: Truck The World by Geo Martinez
products.body:
Master The Truck Position From Geo Martinez And This 10th Planet Back Take System Can Help You Find Submissions In Totally Unique Ways

  • Use this signature 10th Planet grappling attack to take the back and finish fights with one of 10th Planet’s premier competitors and coaches, Geo Martinez
  • Geo Martinez is an elite black belt competitor for 10th Planet and coaches his own students through these creative 10th Planet grappling systems
  • See how anyone can use these techniques and concepts to increase their attack rate, with no special flexibility or speed needed for success
  • Enter the truck position from top, bottom, and tons of unique positions as Geo shows you how this back take system comes from everywhere
  • Use control strategies and slick submission threats for a complete back take style, including crushing calf slicers and twister locks


Master The Truck Position From Geo Martinez And This 10th Planet Back Take System Can Help You Find Submissions In Totally Unique Ways

 

 

What Will You Learn?

Attack in new, dynamic, effective ways with this signature 10th Planet back taking system from black belt competitor and coach Geo Martinez. As one of the top 10th Planet Freaks in the world, Geo shares details and combinations that work against the best and can help you improve your grappling in all-new ways.

Attack The Back In New, Dynamic Ways!

 

 

The truck position is a 10th Planet grappling specialty, and Geo is the best example of this in competition around the world. Whether on top, on bottom, from tons of positions, Geo shows how he has been able to enter into this position from nearly everywhere in a fight, and how to control and finish from there.

Lock Your Control In With These Helpful Tips

 

 

Geo isn’t just a great grappler, he’s a great coach, and he explains in clear detail how to get the most out of the truck position. This 4-volume series will help you increase your back attacks and tap into combinations and styles that you haven’t seen before. You don’t need any special flexibility or athleticism to do these moves, just step-by-step technique as you learn how to truck the world.

Use Sneaky Set Ups For Slick Techniques! 

 

 

So, What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 1:

  • Introduction
  • Basic Truck Entries
  • Prehook From Turtle
  • Samurai Roll Flow
  • Ninja Roll

Part 2:

  • Entries
  • Z Guard - Dog Fight - Twistback - Truck 3 Options
  • 100 Percent - Truck
  • Stack - Truck
  • Rolling Truck
  • Z Guard - Arm Drag - Truck
  • Arm Drag to Truck
  • De X - Truck
  • Reverse De La Riva - Crab Ride - Pizza Truck
  • Knee Staple - Ninja Roll
  • Freak Bolo - Truck
  • Back Truck (Flow)
  • Z Guard Counter

Part 3:

  • Control
  • Cui Control
  • Azusa Control
  • Knee Clamp
  • Lotus Control

Part 4

  • Submissions
  • Calf Slicer
  • Twister Concepts
  • Sneaky Kamikaze
  • Crotch Ripper
  • Trucks Stop
  • Outro

So, What Does It All Cost?

$77

products.title: The 10th Planet Dead Orchard and Truck Finishes by Jeremiah Vance
products.body:
Take A Trip To The 10th Planet With Jeremiah Vance’s Dead Orchard, Truck Position, & More No-Gi Grappling Offense You Can Use To Stun The Competition

  • Jeremiah Vance is a 10th Planet black belt who has been one of their most successful and exciting grapplers for years, and now he gives you insights into some of his best attacks
  • Use the dead orchard closed guard to attack the upper body with incredibly effective armlocks and Jeremiah’s Muddy Waters submission hold
  • Learn how to set up the Truck Position and take the back with step-by-step technique, and options for Calf Crushes, Swedish Twisters, and more
  • Jeremiah shares his insights into super effective 10th Planet systems like the 100% and Homie X, with details that he has gained over years of employing these moves
  • The Dead Orchard is an incredibly controlling form of closed guard that moves you into great position to armbar either side, while keeping your opponents posture and pressure under total control
